title: Artificial intelligence is creating a new global linguistic hierarchy
abstract: arXiv:2602.12018v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to transform healthcare, education, governance and socioeconomic equity, but its benefits remain concentrated in a small number of languages (Bender, 2019; Blasi et al., 2022; Joshi et al., 2020; Ranathunga and de Silva, 2022; Young, 2015). Language AI - the technologies that underpin widely-used conversational systems such as ChatGPT - could provide major benefits if available in people's native languages, yet most of the world's 7,000+ linguistic communities currently lack access and face persistent digital marginalization. Here we present a global longitudinal analysis of social, economic and infrastructural conditions across languages to assess systemic inequalities in language AI. translated_title: 人工智能正在创造一种新的全球语言等级体系
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）有潜力变革医疗保健、教育、治理和社会经济公平，但其收益仍集中于少数语言（Bender, 2019; Blasi et al., 2022; Joshi et al., 2020; Ranathunga and de Silva, 2022; Young, 2015）。语言人工智能——即支撑ChatGPT等广泛使用的对话系统的底层技术——如果能以人们的母语提供，将带来重大收益，然而全球7000多个语言社区中的大多数目前无法获得这些技术，并持续面临数字边缘化。在此，我们对各语言的社会、经济和基础设施条件进行了全球纵向分析，以评估语言人工智能领域存在的系统性不平等。我们首先分析了6003种语言的AI资源存在情况。我们发现，尽管社区努力扩大语言技术的覆盖范围（Bapna et al., 2022; Costa-Jussà et al...
tldr: 该研究通过对6003种语言的社会、经济和基础设施条件进行全球纵向分析，揭示了语言AI资源分布的系统性不平等，表明人工智能正在催生一种使大多数语言社区数字边缘化的新全球语言等级体系。
en_tdlr: Through a global longitudinal analysis of social, economic, and infrastructural conditions across 6,003 languages, this study reveals systemic inequalities in language AI resources, demonstrating that AI is creating a new global linguistic hierarchy that digitally marginalizes most of the world's linguistic communities.
